name: DIVGI TORQTRANSFER SYSTEMS Ltd
title: DIVGI TORQTRANSFER SYSTEMS Ltd - 543812 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue hit a record INR375 crore (+56%) and Q4 hit INR113.8 crore, but the EV unit runs at only 25-30% utilisation and management gave no capacity discipline or capex figures.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue INR113.8 crore, +78% YoY
triggers.quote: We delivered our highest ever quarterly revenue of INR113.8 crores

triggers.label: Indonesia pickup orders ~70,000 units
triggers.quote: the Indonesian government wanted this executed before March 31, 2027

triggers.label: Automatic transmission opportunity INR1,000 crore
triggers.quote: our estimate of INR1,000 crores, actually, we could be accused of being too conservative

guidance.quote: the company continues to maintain a medium-term target of 20% to 25% export contribution to overall revenues

guidance.metric: Components annual revenue from newly secured programs
guidance.quote: the newly secured component programs are expected to contribute annual revenues nearing INR100 crores

guidance.metric: EV volumes after new model launch
guidance.quote: we are expecting almost a doubling of the EV volumes
the company expects to maintain a healthy net cash position

red_flags.label: Indonesia order-on-hold media report dismissed by management
red_flags.quote: there was a certain amount of media narrative that was being pushed

red_flags.label: EV utilisation 25-30% with delayed launches
red_flags.quote: one of our new products that was supposed to launch last year, it got delayed

evasions.topic: Indonesia order timing / media hold reports
evasions.quote: there was a certain amount of media narrative that was being pushed

evasions.topic: Capacity utilisation and FY27 EV utilisation target
